why.floor: none - additive across every touched frozen suite (classify-edit-class ADDITIVE on all four, 19+4+6+3 added, 0 modified, 0 removed), so each self-clears and stays frozen and no Clearance is owed. The two new suites are frozen for the first time at this gate. One apparent step-append in gate-verdicts was independently traced by the judge to a missing trailing newline, not a content change
why.blast: medium - doctrine on the SDD self-spec's authoring and mission capabilities: two new behavioral nodes plus additive contract on the spec gate, the spec-producer, the conductor and the cross-capability workflow suite. No engine, no runtime code, no package surface. Every future mission reads what this changes, which is the reach that makes it medium rather than low
why.novelty: medium - one genuinely new mechanism, a pre-flight stage that corroborates against the artifact rather than the declaration, plus two nodes for procedures that previously existed only as prose distributed across two bars. The two design forks with real freedom were resolved on evidence and recorded: mode-gating over declaration-gating, and added-unit over changed-unit
why.confidence: high - cold spec-judge ALIGNED true on all three lenses across two consecutive independent rounds, the second confirming the post-verdict deltas. Miss test passes on all 62 scenarios against named wrong subjects. The route was not clean: rounds 1 and 2 failed all three lenses, round 2 found two regressions against round 1's own remediation, and the loop was stopped and re-planned rather than iterated. Two of the CR's own defects were self-inflicted and mechanical, including a bad edit anchor that truncated the flagship node. The CR passes its own new tells, which is the cheapest evidence the mechanism is usable by the party it polices. Limits are disclosed in the spec rather than asserted away: tell coverage is two bars of the expected set, a producer writing no surface trace at all is exempt from that tell, and nothing yet owns how the conductor decides producer_mode

summary: no frozen scenario covers the spec gate skill's own cold-judge spawn payload. contradicts: the change request claims the step-record tell cannot be opted out of by the party it polices; on the gate path it could be opted out of by nobody at all
evidence: the gate skill's spawn instruction previously said to pass the spec and feature only
the gate skill contains no reference to any pre-flight field or finding-kind
found by the cold impl-judge's orthogonal structural read, not by any frozen scenario

summary: the shipped skill and agent definitions have no mechanical check reconciling the declared fields of an Input, Output or payload block against the prose that mandates them. contradicts: this change request installs a mechanism whose correctness depends on fields arriving across a four-participant dispatch channel; nothing checks that the channel's declared shape and its prose agree
evidence: a canonical payload block was added to fix the class and itself omitted a required field
a collect step gained a field while the sibling report block in the same file was not swept
